'''Phantothief''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Zorrock]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "If you want to take on Phantothief, keep a tight watch on the cookies, keys, and other pretty trinkets in your pocket. Between the seductive smiles and gestures, however, this handsome thief just might snatch something even more precious. Someone's heart, perhaps?"

Phantothief is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A brown raccoon that wears a blue eye mask, cape, and vest. It holds a red cane with both hands. Phantothief stands bipedal and has off-white, orange, and red accents in its fur. Its striped tail is significantly larger than its body and has spiked blue fur at the end.

Phantothief's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes instances of blue to green.

== Trivia ==
* Phantothief and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/8/2026 alongside [[Blechlama]] and [[Morphanessa]].
